class.name: LLMContext
class.brief_description: Inference context with TurboQuant KV cache configuration.
class.description: Wraps a llama.cpp [code]llama_context*[/code]. Configures context length, threading, flash attention, and KV cache quantization — including TurboQuant types ([code]turbo2[/code], [code]turbo3[/code], [code]turbo4[/code]). The default configuration ([code]cache_type_k = "q8_0"[/code], [code]cache_type_v = "turbo4"[/code]) is validated safe for Q4_K_M base weights on all platforms. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var ctx = LLMContext.new() ctx.n_ctx = 32768 ctx.cache_type_k = "q8_0" # K at 8-bit (controls attention routing quality) ctx.cache_type_v = "turbo4" # V at 4-bit TurboQuant (3.8x compression, +1% PPL) ctx.create(model) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: create
method.description: Creates the inference context from a loaded [LLMModel]. Must be called after [method LLMModel.load]. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Frees the inference context and releases KV cache memory.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the context has been successfully created.

members.member: KV cache quantization type for the Key cache. Valid values: [code]f16[/code], [code]q8_0[/code], [code]q4_0[/code], [code]turbo2[/code], [code]turbo3[/code], [code]turbo4[/code]. [b]Recommendation:[/b] Keep at [code]q8_0[/code] — K precision directly controls attention routing quality. Symmetric turbo on K can be catastrophic on some model families.

KV cache quantization type for the Value cache. Valid values: [code]f16[/code], [code]q8_0[/code], [code]q4_0[/code], [code]turbo2[/code], [code]turbo3[/code], [code]turbo4[/code]. [b]Recommendation:[/b] [code]turbo4[/code] gives 3.8× compression at +1% PPL. [code]turbo3[/code] gives 5.1× at +2% PPL. V compression is essentially free — it does not affect attention routing.
Enable Flash Attention for faster prefill at long context.
Number of CPU threads for inference. Ignored when all layers are on GPU.
